subject: Clearhaven RTO/RPO attestation workbook and sampling request
messages:
From: Sandra Lowe <sandra.lowe@clearhaven.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: ops@clearhaven.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RTO/RPO attestation workbook + sampling request

Vivek —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. As part of our SOC 2 evidence intake for Clearhaven's vendor review, our security team needs a concise attestation of your RTO/RPO claims for the Hosted API and Dedicated clusters that will be in our scope. Specifically we need: 

1) A completed attestation workbook that maps your stated SLAs to the concrete provable artifacts (runbook excerpts, telemetry queries, snapshot timestamps).
2) A small, reproducible RPO sampling extract (CSV) showing the KV snapshot timestamps and the delta to user-visible replay times for three recent warm-start events.
3) A short (10–15 minute) tabletop recording or transcript that walks through your failover steps for a regional warm-cache restore.

Can you provide the workbook and the sample CSV by EOD Friday PST? We may request a live witness after that. If you need to schedule a short prep call with our ops reviewer (I can loop them in), let me know windows tomorrow.

Thanks —
Sandra Lowe
Security Program Manager
Clearhaven Systems

[attachment: SOC2-evidence-template-guidance.pdf]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Sandra Lowe <sandra.lowe@clearhaven.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO attestation workbook + sampling request

Hi Sandra —

Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a compact attestation workbook and the requested CSV sample. Plan below: 

- Workbook: Kimberly will fill the mapping table (SLA → artifact) and include direct telemetry query snippets and runbook excerpts.
- RPO sample CSV: Marissa will extract three warm-start events from our KV retention store (2027-01-19, 2027-01-27, 2027-02-07) and include the exact timestamps and calculated deltas.
- Tabletop walk-through: we can record a 12-minute walkthrough and provide either the recording or a transcript.

We'll aim to deliver the workbook + CSV by EOD Friday PST (2027-02-12). If you need it sooner, we can prioritize the 2027-02-07 snapshot first.

Kimberly/marissa — can you own the artifacts above and confirm by EOD today?

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[signature: mobile 415-555-0192]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO attestation workbook + sampling request

Vivek — confirmed. Quick notes on evidence slices: 

- Runbook excerpts: I'll include the exact section numbers for warm-cache restore and the checklist we use for failover invocation (ops playbook v4.1, sections 3.2–3.5).
- Telemetry queries: we'll paste the PromQL/snippets and a minimal explanation of the metrics used to compute perceived recovery time.
- RPO sampling: Marissa will attach a CSV with columns [event_id, cluster_id, kv_snapshot_ts, replay_visible_ts, delta_seconds].

Ben — can you prepare a short keystore-access statement for the workbook (attestation that key material rotation won't affect restore path) and PRiyom, can you add a short note about our cross-region replication lag characteristics (summary, not raw traces)?

I expect the initial package ready for internal review by Thursday EOD PST. If Clearhaven wants live witness, we should propose Monday 2027-02-15 for a 30-minute session.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Platform Security Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment stub: ops-playbook-v4.1-excerpt.pdf]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sandra Lowe <sandra.lowe@clearhaven.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Submission: Clearhaven RTO/RPO attestation workbook + sample CSV

Sandra — attaching the requested materials for your intake: 

- RTO-RPO-attestation-workbook-v1.xlsx (mapping table + supporting citations)
- rpo-sample-chunk-20270207.csv (3 sampled warm-start events; see notes column)
- kv-cache-snapshot-20270207.tar.gz (ops extract of KV manifest; hash: sha256:abc123... )
- tabletop-recording-link.txt (short Loom recording of warm-cache restore: https://loom.com/share/xyz-clearhaven)

Key callouts: 
- The workbook includes the exact telemetry queries and runbook section links used to assert the <5 min warm-cache RTO for small-tenant failovers.
- The CSV shows measured deltas (median 85s, max 210s) and includes the replay-visible_ts as served by the public API logs (privacy-safe IDs).
- Keystore rotation does not block restore; ben_carter has signed the keystore attestation in the workbook.

If this looks good, please confirm and tell us if you'd like a live witness. We can schedule a 30-minute session on Mon/Tue next week (we recommended Mon 2027-02-15 09:00–11:00 PST).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference

[attachments: RTO-RPO-attestation-workbook-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), rpo-sample-chunk-20270207.csv (text/csv), kv-cache-snapshot-20270207.tar.gz (archive), tabletop-recording-link.txt (text)]
